line.en: Yesterday (Nov 24) both coins fell again after reversing all of Monday's rally: ETH from 1,708.48 to 1,677.59 (low 1,662.03), BTC from 61,176.41 to 59,740.87 (low 59,199.02). Automatic bias 3/3 gradable (ETH hit on both close and ny, BTC only gradable on ny, hit). Text predictions 0/8: the two cited ceilings (1,696.50 ETH, 61,405.52 BTC, on both runs) broke to the downside on 15-minute closes early (02:25 UTC on ETH, 01:25 UTC on BTC) and both ranges too. Zones 1/8 touched-and-won: on the close ETH's B sell (overnight-high sweep) worked (r 0.21) but the B reclaim buy stopped out; both of BTC's (the bearish-gap sell, the golden-pocket bounce) broke without reclaiming. On the ny the same four zones from the close (the method doesn't re-grade them) went untouched, already resolved or broken before that window.
